newsitem.title: UK: BOE- JULY RPI FIGURES DO NOT CHANGE INFLATION VIEW.
newsitem.headline: BOE- JULY RPI FIGURES DO NOT CHANGE INFLATION VIEW.

text.p: A leap in underlying British inflation in July did not change the Bank of England's view of of inflation prospects, Bank deputy governor Mervyn King said on Tuesday.
"The inflation numbers which came out yesterday are not ones which change our view for the prospects for inflation," King told a press conference.
RPIX jumped to 3.0 percent year-on-year in July, from 2.7 in June, largely boosted by budget duty changes for petrol.

King also said fiscal policy was not responsible for controlling inflation but said fiscal measures introduced by Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown in his first budget will hit household spending at some point.
"We do believe that in the end taxes fall on households...and may reduce consumption from households at some time or another," King said.
"The responsibility for inflation lies with monetary policy," he added.
